issues.title: Truncated Build Script Logic
issues.why: The provided context for 04-build-scripts.md and 06-cleanup.md is truncated due to the 120KB cap, leaving the Bash implementation of cleanup and the end of the build script logic missing.
issues.fix: Consult the full version of 04-build-scripts.md and 06-cleanup.md in the repository to complete the implementation.

issues.title: Ambiguous Rollback Trigger in Handoff
issues.why: While AC-17 was patched to clarify ownership, the interaction between the blocking cmd.Run() in the parent and the detached updater's failure state creates a potential race or 'zombie' state if the parent is killed during the wait.
issues.fix: Ensure the updater process explicitly handles SIGPIPE/parent-death by checking the parent PID status before proceeding with the final swap.

issues.title: Missing Unit for Cleanup Latency
issues.why: AC-16 specifies a 100ms budget but does not explicitly define if this is CPU time or wall-clock time in the normative text (though the changelog claims it was patched).
issues.fix: Explicitly label the 100ms limit as 'wall-clock time' within the body of 06-cleanup.md.
